howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能生成一份 10 页的投资人 Pitch Deck，包含封面、问题、解决方案、市场规模、数据图表、商业模式、团队等标准板块。
howto.when: 当你需要制作融资演示文稿，尤其是面向投资人的种子轮或 A 轮 Pitch Deck 时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份 10 页的融资 Pitch Deck。
say.note: Claude 会按模板输出完整 deck。

say.text: 为我的 SaaS 项目做一份投资人演示文稿。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含市场分析和融资额度的 deck。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a 10-page investor pitch deck covering cover, problem, solution, market size, traction chart, business model, team, and ask.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create a fundraising presentation, especially a seed or Series A pitch deck for investors.

say_en.text: Generate a 10-page fundraising pitch deck for me.
say_en.note: Claude will output a complete deck following the template.

say_en.text: Create an investor presentation for my SaaS project.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a deck including market analysis and funding ask.
